rows: Day-wise – every campaign, ad set and ad, Sep 1 to Nov 25 (newest first)

Use the filter on Date / Level, or the + / − buttons to open ad sets and ads under each campaign-day. D-3 / D-7 = the same campaign, ad set or ad 3 and 7 days earlier (blank if it did not spend that day). Budget = daily budget in force at the end of that day (rebuilt from the activity log; campaign = sum of its ad sets that ran). Every day since Sep 1 is kept.
Ret Effective CPI (₹) = Adjust CPI ÷ that day's retention index
